parts.tooltip: Cont r a = (a ⟶ r) ⟶ r — a suspended computation waiting for its continuation k
(a ⟶ Cont r b) — given result a, builds the next continuation-based step
bind m f = \\k -> m (\\a -> f a k)\nGive m a continuation that: feeds a into f, then passes original k to the result.\nThe current step runs last — this is continuation composition.
Cont r b = (b ⟶ r) ⟶ r — the composed computation; callCC can capture k here for early exit
